exercise.instruction_pt: Listen. What does the chair decide?
exercise.listen: We're running out of time, so let's park the budget question and come back to it next week.
options: To discuss the budget next week
exercise.explanation_pt: "Park the budget question and come back to it next week" é deixar o assunto para a semana que vem.

exercise.instruction_pt: Listen. What is true?
exercise.listen: If I'd seen your message earlier, I would have picked you up at the airport.
options: The speaker didn't see the message in time.
The speaker picked the person up.
The speaker will go to the airport later.
exercise.explanation_pt: O terceiro condicional fala de algo que não aconteceu: a pessoa não viu a mensagem a tempo e não foi ao aeroporto.

exercise.instruction_pt: Listen. How often does the speaker eat out?
exercise.listen: With two kids and a mortgage, we only eat out once in a blue moon.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Once in a blue moon" significa muito raramente.

exercise.instruction_pt: Listen to your colleague. Then report it to your boss, starting with "He said...".
exercise.listen: I can't come to the meeting because I'm seeing a client.
accepted: He said he couldn't come to the meeting because he was seeing a client
He said that he couldn't come to the meeting because he was seeing a client
He said he couldn't come because he was seeing a client
He said he can't come to the meeting because he's seeing a client
He said he can't come because he's seeing a client
He said he couldn't make it to the meeting because he was seeing a client
He said he couldn't come to the meeting because he was meeting a client
He said he couldn't come to the meeting because he had a client

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao relatar, troque o pronome: o "I" dele vira "he": "He said he couldn't come".
commonErrors.correction_en: He said he couldn't come to the meeting because he was seeing a client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa direto. Use "He told me..." ou "He said...".
commonErrors.correction_en: He said he couldn't come to the meeting.

exercise.instruction_pt: You are the agent. Listen and respond with empathy.
exercise.listen: I ordered a laptop two weeks ago and it still hasn't arrived!
accepted: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into it
I'm really sorry to hear that. Let me look into it for you
I'm so sorry about that. I'll look into it right away
I understand your frustration. Let me check what happened
I'm sorry for the delay. Let me look into it
I apologize for the delay. Let me check your order
I'm sorry about that. Could I have your order number, please?
I'm sorry to hear that. Could I have your order number?
I completely understand. Let me see what I can do

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "I'm sorry to hear that", com "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Verificar" um problema é "look into it". "Look for" é procurar algo perdido.
commonErrors.correction_en: Let me look into it for you.

exercise.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Se vocês pagarem adiantado, a gente pode dar um desconto."
accepted: If you pay upfront, we can give you a discount
If you pay upfront, we could give you a discount
If you pay in advance, we can give you a discount
If you pay in advance, we could give you a discount
If you pay up front, we can offer you a discount
If you pay upfront, we can offer a discount
If you pay in advance, we can offer you a discount
We can give you a discount if you pay upfront
We could give you a discount if you pay in advance

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" na condição, use o presente: "If you pay upfront".
commonErrors.correction_en: If you pay upfront, we can give you a discount.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Dar um desconto" é "give" ou "offer a discount", não "make".
commonErrors.correction_en: If you pay upfront, we can give you a discount.

exercise.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu pretendo conversar com ele para resolver isso."
accepted: I intend to talk to him to sort this out
I'm planning to talk to him to sort this out
I plan to talk to him to sort this out
I'm going to talk to him to sort this out
I'm going to talk to him to sort it out
I'm going to talk to him to solve this
I plan to talk to him to resolve this
I intend to speak to him to sort this out
I'm going to have a talk with him to sort this out

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pretend" significa fingir. "Pretender" é "intend", "plan" ou "be going to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I intend to talk to him to sort this out.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para indicar finalidade usamos "to": "to sort this out".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm going to talk to him to sort this out.

exercise.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Atualmente, as pessoas trabalham mais de casa."
accepted: Nowadays, people work from home more
Nowadays, people work more from home
These days, people work from home more
These days, people work more from home
Currently, people work from home more
Nowadays, more people work from home
These days, more people work from home
People work from home more nowadays
People work more from home these days

commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays, people work from home more.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao falar de pessoas em geral, não use "the": "people work".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays, people work from home more.
Nowadays, people work from home more.

exercise.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Você pode me explicar como funciona?"
accepted: Can you explain to me how it works?
Could you explain to me how it works?
Can you explain how it works?
Could you explain how it works?
Can you tell me how it works?
Could you tell me how it works?
Could you walk me through how it works?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Explain" pede "to" antes da pessoa: "explain to me". Ou use "tell me".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you explain to me how it works?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Dentro de outra pergunta, a ordem é de afirmação: "how it works".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you explain how it works?

exercise.instruction_pt: Convince your friend to join you on a weekend trip. Answer the objection.
exercise.prompt_en: A weekend trip sounds nice, but it's too expensive and I'm really busy right now.
guidelines_pt: Give two benefits: "Not only..., but also..."
Close with a question: "What have we got to lose?"

exercise.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Match each idiom to its meaning.

pairs.en: cost an arm and a leg

exercise.instruction_pt: "Na Itália é costume almoçar tarde." Which word means "costume" here?
exercise.explanation_pt: "Custom" é costume, tradição. "Costume" em inglês é fantasia.

exercise.instruction_pt: You want your money back. What do you ask for?
exercise.explanation_pt: Dinheiro de volta é "refund". "Devolution" e "reclamation" são falsos cognatos.

exercise.instruction_pt: Sales stopped going up and stayed stable. Sales...
exercise.explanation_pt: "Level off" é estabilizar depois de subir ou cair.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete with the right form of "be".
exercise.sentence: If I ___ you, I'd take the job.
accepted: were
was

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para se imaginar no lugar de alguém: "If I were you" (ou "was", mais informal).
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd take the job.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete with the right form of "wake".
exercise.sentence: I'm not used to ___ up so early.
accepted: waking

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "be used to" o verbo vai com -ing: "used to waking up".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm not used to waking up so early.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete with the passive form of "check".
exercise.sentence: All the documents are ___ before they are sent.
accepted: checked

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na voz passiva o verbo vai no particípio: "are checked".
commonErrors.correction_en: All the documents are checked before they are sent.

exercise.instruction_pt: Put the words in order.
accepted: She asked me where I had parked the car

exercise.instruction_pt: Which sentence is correct?
options: Not only is it cheaper, but it's also faster.
Not only it is cheaper, but it's also faster.
Not only cheaper is it, but also faster.
exercise.explanation_pt: Quando a frase começa com "Not only", há inversão: "Not only is it...".
